about.title: Friendly help when you need it
paragraphs: Martinez Auto Repair is Jaime's shop on Jefferson Street. When you break down and other shops are busy or closed, we do our best to get you fixed and back on your way.
about.photo_alt: Car with the hood up on the roadside

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and Jaime will get back to you. Or call (541) 370-4199 (Mon–Sat: 8am–5pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Jaime will get back to you soon to set up a time.

services.name: Emergency Repairs
services.blurb: Broke down? We do our best to get you going.
services.intro: Broken down on the way through The Dalles? Call us. We'll find the parts and get you back on the road as quickly as we can, Saturdays included.
photos: Car with the hood up on the roadside
Mechanic working on an engine with a wrench

services.name: Diagnostics
services.blurb: Check engine lights and hard-to-find problems.
services.intro: Warning lights, strange noises and problems that come and go, tracked down to the real cause so you only pay for the repair you need.
photos: Scan tool plugged into a car

services.name: Maintenance & Oil Changes
services.blurb: Oil changes, filters, fluids and scheduled service.
services.intro: Regular maintenance keeps your car running right and catches small problems before they turn into big ones.
